title: Nationals @ Reds
summary: Reds bring the cleaner multi-layer case, with the market, listed starter shape, standings profile, and bullpen follow-through all leaning their way at Great American Ball Park.
lean: Lean Reds if the cleaner starter-to-bullpen chain and standings profile still hold once the late innings start to matter.
factors: Current board: Nationals +119 / Reds -143 | O10 (-112) / U10 (-108) | Nationals +1.5 (-163) / Reds -1.5 (+135).
Miles Mikolas enters with the softer ERA baseline, so early traffic could flip the whole script quickly.
Nationals enter 19-22, 4th in division, -13 RD; Reds enter 22-19, 5th in division, -33 RD.
Nationals offense: 8.27 H/G with 7.67 over the last three; Reds offense: 7.27 H/G with 6.33 over the last three.
Nationals bullpen: 4.84 ERA and 1.44 WHIP; Reds bullpen: 4.46 ERA and 1.55 WHIP.
swingFactor: Swing factor: whether Mikolas can keep the ball in the yard long enough to stop Great American Ball Park from amplifying an early mistake.
